offering_description.value: Develops, manufactures and sells vaccines, antitoxins and therapeutics, plus emergency medical countermeasures such as naloxone nasal spray, for chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear threats and public health emergencies. Customers are mainly governments, with some commercial and consumer sales. Products are made in its own manufacturing facilities.

primary_products.value: anthrax vaccines; smallpox and mpox vaccines; naloxone nasal spray; antitoxins and antibody therapeutics; travel vaccines

customer_segment.value: B2G: US government (HHS/BARDA, Strategic National Stockpile, DoD) and allied governments; B2B: distributors, wholesalers and international partners; B2C: consumers buying over-the-counter naloxone and travel vaccines

end_markets.value: public health preparedness; biodefense; opioid overdose emergency response; infectious disease prevention; travel health

revenue_model.value: product sales: vaccines, therapeutics and naloxone sold to governments and distributors; project or contract: government development and procurement contracts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: develops and manufactures biologics and drugs, sold to governments and distributors; brand owner: markets branded vaccines and over-the-counter naloxone

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe and other international government customers

specialization.value: related lines: vaccines, antitoxins/therapeutics and overdose-reversal products for public health threats

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: contracts with governments for stockpile procurement; distributors / dealers: wholesalers supplying pharmacies and healthcare providers; third-party retail: pharmacies selling over-the-counter naloxone
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: high: vaccines and drugs requiring FDA and EMA approval and cGMP manufacturing oversight, government contracting rules

notes: Portfolio may have changed through divestitures; verify current product list.
